messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT: Elevated 429/503 rates on embeddings (us-west-2). Threshold breached (5m avg 429 = 12%). See dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/embeddings-429
alex: ack — I'm oncall, pulling dashboards and logs now.
maya: standby to take handoff after mitigation if needed.
alex: quick triage: spike correlates to a bulk import job from tenant acme-corp, QPS ~6x normal. Errors are primarily 429 with some 503s on proxy layer.
support-ops: customer case created and linked. They report "timeouts for large batch imports". Notifying CS to send an interim note.
alex: mitigation plan (short): 1) apply global embeddings guardrail to limit overall qps 2) apply emergency per-tenant cap for acme-corp 3) disable heavy batching in us-west-2 to reduce burstiness 4) watch dashboards and iterate.
alex: applying global guardrail now:
```
# ops: set global embeddings qps cap
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/ops/limits -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"scope":"embeddings","global_qps":200}'
```
ops-bot: ACTION: global embeddings guardrail set to 200 qps by alex at 3055551241
ops-bot: ACTION: applying per-tenant cap for tenant=acme-corp qps=50
alex: per-tenant cap applied.
ops-bot: FLAG: embeddings.heavy_batching=false (region=us-west-2) set by alex
alex: disabled heavy_batching flag in us-west-2 to force smaller requests and smoother KV cache behavior.
maya: dashboard update: 1m 429 avg dropping from 12% -> 6% within 3m of guardrail. 503s also trending down. Link: https://dash.redwood/graph?m=embeddings-us-west2
sam: logs show two internal importers not honoring backoff headers — reached out to acme infra and left guidance to add exponential backoff.
support-ops: customer update posted: "We applied temporary throttles to stabilize the service; we expect recovery in ~15 minutes. We'll follow up with root cause." :wave:
alex: setting a 10m reminder to reassess and lift temporary caps if stable.
ops-bot: REMINDER: reassess embeddings caps in 10m (set by alex)
maya: if 429 < 2% and latency stable after reassess, we'll lift per-tenant cap then re-enable batching with a gradual ramp.
alex: leaving incident in maya's hands at 3055551899 for rollback / postmortem followup. Thanks.
maya: taking handoff. I'll run a controlled re-enable if safe and capture metrics. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INCIDENT: status moved to MONITORING by maya at 3055551899
pagerbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 429/503 rates returned to baseline. Auto-close scheduled.
